$comment: Inventory of the signature sets this build ships with, and where to
fetch updates. The updater downloads the mirror's copy of this file,
compares 'version', and installs any bundle whose sha256 differs from
the local copy. Checksums here are authoritative: a download whose
hash does not match is discarded, never installed.
The sha256 values below are null because the bundled files are
placeholders. The real manifest is generated by the release pipeline

bundles.name: hashes.db
bundles.description: SQLite database of known-malware digests, built from public feeds.

bundles.name: main.cvd
bundles.notice: Distributed by Cisco Systems, Inc. Not redistributed with this package; fetched from the upstream mirror at update time.

bundles.name: core.yar
bundles.description: Curated YARA rules maintained by this project.

rules/example.yar.description: Worked example rules shipped with the package. Loaded alongside any downloaded rules.
